_source: Hand-worked in bsd-worked-template-v2.xlsx, tier by tier. Not derived from engine code.

_conventions.banding: Marginal: each slice of the value is taxed at its own band's rate. An amount exactly on a boundary sits in the lower band.
_conventions.rounding: Total duty rounded DOWN to the whole dollar, minimum $1 (IRAS). Different from CPF interest rounding (D12) on purpose.

_tiersNote: Copied from ruleset-2026-08-24.json (transactionCosts.buyerStampDutyTiers), same shape: ratePercent, portion in DOLLARS, last portion 'remainder'. Kept here so a ruleset update can't silently change these expected values.

cases.description: Exactly on the tier 1/2 boundary: all in the 1% band
One dollar above the boundary: that dollar at 2% ($0.02), then floored
Nominal $1 transaction: $0.01 floors to $0, so the $1 minimum applies
